ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Mars

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The sextile between Venus and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.
